// Instruction layout (17 bits): {op[1:0], waddr[4:0], raddr1[4:0], raddr2[4:0]}
// op: 00=add  01=sub  10=mul  11=mul (op[1] selects mul)

// mem[2] <- mem[0] + mem[1]

// mem[3] <- mem[0] - mem[1]

10_00100_00000_00001
// mem[5] <- mem[2] + mem[3]
00_00101_00010_00011
